The '''Japai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilots [[Kraigg]], [[Tabba]] and [[Lady Blue]] were killed after embarking on a reconnaissance mission.{{System-stub}}
